question: What do we know about the generational wealth transfer, and how are these five preparing for it?

cells.label: fact

items.text: Schwab states its retail business attracts younger clients, with approximately 70% of new-to-firm retail households being Gen Z and millennials, and that it is well positioned to retain assets when wealth passes to next generations, with an extremely high retention rate around wealth transfers.
items.quote: approximately 70% of new-to-firm retail households are Gen Z and millennials... we are well positioned to continue serving future generations when that wealth is passed on. Our retention rate around wealth transfers is extremely high, and we are winning assets with all generations.

items.text: Schwab's retail investor deck states ~75% of assets are retained in a wealth transfer event, with ~70% of new-to-firm retail households being Gen Z and Millennials and 80% of retail assets held by ultra-high/high net worth households.
items.quote: ATTRACT ~70% NTF Retail HH are Gen Z & Millennials; SERVE 80% Retail Assets Held by U/HNW HHs; RETAIN ~75% Assets Retained in a Wealth Transfer Event
items.unit: assets retained in a wealth transfer event

items.text: Schwab is investing in both people and technology to continue building, deepening and retaining trusted client relationships, citing that retail clients with a dedicated financial consultant generate about 3x household net new assets and 5x managed investing net flows.
items.quote: Relationships continue to matter. That is why we are investing in both people and technology so we can continue building, deepening and retaining those trusted relationships now and for the decades to come.

items.text: Schwab is enhancing its tax, trust and estate capabilities, including plans to offer wealth.com's estate planning tools to retail clients, as part of meeting the holistic needs of clients.
items.quote: We are enhancing our tax trust and estate capabilities, including plans to offer wealth.com's estate planning tools to our retail clients.

items.text: Schwab invested in tax, trust, and estate capabilities and added more experts to support more clients as part of deepening client relationships.
items.quote: We've invested in tax, trust, and estate capabilities, and we've added more experts to support more clients.

items.text: Schwab took an ownership stake in Wealth.com and began rolling out their estate analysis capability to its specialists, giving more tools to help clients integrate estate planning into their investment life.
items.quote: We took an ownership stake in Wealth.com and began rolling out their estate analysis capability to our specialists, giving us more tools to help clients integrate their estate planning into their investment life.

items.text: Schwab increased its strategic investment in Wealth.com, which it is using to bring AI-powered estate planning tools to clients, and is working to launch an AI-powered tax planning capability.
items.quote: We also increased our strategic investment in Wealth.com, which we are already using to bring AI-powered estate planning tools to our clients. We're also working to launch their AI-powered tax planning capability in the near future.

items.text: Schwab launched the Schwab Teen Investor Account for young people ages 13-17, a hands-on investing experience to attract the next generation.
items.quote: Launched the Schwab Teen InvestorTM Account, a unique and hands-on investing experience for young people ages 13 - 17

items.text: Schwab's advisor center will offer access to Wealth.com's Ester, an AI-powered tax and estate planning tool, to help advisors address tax and estate conversations clients increasingly call for.
items.quote: Schwab announced that its advisor center would offer access to Wealth.com's Ester, an artificial intelligence-powered tax and estate planning tool.

cells.reason: The passages describe Schwab's specific initiatives to retain assets across generational wealth transfers (estate planning tools, high wealth transfer retention rates, next-generation attraction).
